stekbord.title: Stainless Steel BBQ Hotplate – Perfect for Meat, Veggies & Smash Burgers
stekbord.descriptionHtml:
Turn your BBQ into a versatile outdoor kitchen with this rugged stainless steel BBQ hotplate.
Perfect for cooking meat, fish, veggies, eggs, pancakes, smash burgers and plenty more, right on the BBQ. The smooth stainless steel surface spreads heat evenly and makes it easy to cook for the whole family or a backyard full of guests.

Measuring 43.18 cm x 32.51 cm x 5.58 cm, the hotplate fits most standard BBQs and is big enough to handle several ingredients at once. The raised edges stop food and fat from running over, making cooking smoother and cleaner.

Features:

  • Made from hard-wearing stainless steel – built to last

  • Generous size: 43.18 x 32.51 x 5.58 cm

  • Even heat distribution for a perfect sear

  • High edges prevent fat and food spills

  • Easy to clean and maintain

  • Makes your BBQ more versatile – from meat and fish to pancakes and veggies

Why choose a BBQ hotplate?

A BBQ hotplate is a must for anyone who wants to take their barbecuing to the next level. It gives you that teppanyaki or griddle feel and lets you cook food that would otherwise be tricky or impossible on standard grill grates.

Perfect for weeknight dinners and big BBQ nights alike – with the hotplate you get more variety, better control and, above all, more fun cooking!

seo.title: Stainless Steel BBQ Hotplate | The BBQ Clinic
seo.description: Heavy-duty stainless steel BBQ hotplate for meat, veggies, eggs and smash burgers. Even heat, raised edges, easy to clean. BBQ accessories Australia.

grillblasaren-turbo.title: Turbo BBQ Blower – Fire Up Your BBQ Fast
grillblasaren-turbo.descriptionHtml:
No more waiting around for the coals – get your BBQ going in no time!
With the Turbo BBQ Blower you easily breathe life into charcoal or briquettes without firelighter fluid. It's compact, lightweight and easy to use – perfect for the backyard BBQ, camping or a day out.

The powerful airflow gets your BBQ up to temperature fast, saving you both time and energy.

Features:

  • Fast lighting of charcoal and briquettes

  • Easy to use – just press and blow

  • Compact and easy to take along

  • Perfect for the BBQ, open fires or camping

  • Reduces the need for firelighter fluid

With the Turbo BBQ Blower your BBQ is always ready when you are – more time barbecuing, less waiting!

seo.title: Turbo BBQ Blower – Fast Charcoal Starter
seo.description: Get your charcoal BBQ going in no time – no firelighter fluid needed. Compact, lightweight BBQ blower for the backyard, camping and picnics.

knivsliop.title: 4-Stage Knife Sharpener – Multifunctional with Scissor Sharpener & Non-Slip Base
knivsliop.descriptionHtml:
Make your knives like new again with this clever 4-stage knife sharpener. It has separate slots for coarse, medium and fine sharpening, plus a dedicated slot for scissors.

The ergonomic rubber handle makes it comfortable to use, while the non-slip rubber base adds extra stability and safety. Perfect for kitchen knives, scissors and any other blades you want to keep razor sharp.

  • 4 sharpening stages for the best results

  • Coarse, medium and fine, plus a scissor sharpener

  • Ergonomic rubber handle

  • Non-slip rubber base for stability

  • Easy to use – for beginners and pros alike
